title: Breached Alias with Old Password Risk
dataSources: Breach alerts (`hibp:alert`), password age snapshots (`passwordage:account`), backup restore tests (`backuprestore:test`), and DNS leak checks (`dnsleak:check`).
app: Personal security telemetry from Have I Been Pwned, password-age exports, backup restore drills, and DNS leak checks sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hibp:alert
| search password_age_days=*
| stats count as breach_alerts avg(password_age_days) as avg_password_age_days by identity_name
| sort 0 - breach_alerts
description: Ranks identitiess by breached aliases still tied to old passwords.
value: Combining breach exposure with old-password age creates a much more realistic personal risk queue.
implementation: Send breached aliases still tied to old passwords events to `index=personal` and keep `identity_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of breached aliases still tied to old passwords by identities.
grandmaExplanation: It builds which identitiess stand out most for breached aliases still tied to old passwords.
